mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0%), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and labor market strength (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a consumer price index above 6.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates and reducing equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and in a monetary tightening cycle, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for residential construction, supporting economic growth and predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with rising HOUST, or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index) signals a weakening supply chain and potential economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market strength (PAYEMS rising) and monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) signal an overheating economy, prompting aggressive rate hikes that depress equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a deceleration in GDP growth below 2.0% annually signals an economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 2.0% during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in this regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
